note: Set A is better because it avoids the semantic errors found in Set B, such as mislabeling theta_k as a 'pitch sensitivity intercept' (it is an angle value) and extracting the doubling ratio '2' as a 'pitch sensitivity' value. Both sets contain numerical inaccuracies regarding the 'last data point' (-90E+6 vs the visually correct -120E+6) and the zero-angle original data point (-30E+6 vs the explicit text box -25.52E+6), but Set A's claims are generally more faithful to the variable definitions. Set A does contain significant redundancy with multiple claims for the same value.
